clear_cases.query: 按客户等级统计客户数量
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_level,COUNT(customer_id) n FROM customers GROUP BY customer_level

clear_cases.query: 计算2026年8月各订单状态的订单数量占全部订单数量的比例
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT status,COUNT(order_id)*1.0/SUM(COUNT(order_id)) OVER() ratio FROM orders_current WHERE order_date>='2026-08-01' AND order_date<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY status

clear_cases.query: 统计2026年8月华东地区各客户等级的实付销售额
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_level,SUM(o.paid_amount) sales FROM orders_current o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.region='华东' AND o.order_date>='2026-08-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY c.customer_level

clear_cases.query: 查询2026年8月同时拥有已支付和已退款订单的客户名称
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM orders_current o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date>='2026-08-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY c.customer_name HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status='已支付' THEN 1 END)>0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status='已退款' THEN 1 END)>0

clear_cases.query: 计算2026年8月各产品类别实付金额相对于订单原始金额的比例
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT category,SUM(paid_amount)/NULLIF(SUM(order_amount),0) ratio FROM orders_current WHERE order_date>='2026-08-01' AND order_date<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY category

clear_cases.query: 统计2026年8月各大区订单的实付金额
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT region,SUM(paid_amount) sales FROM orders WHERE ordered_at>='2026-08-01' AND ordered_at<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY region

clear_cases.query: 统计成功和失败支付分别有多少笔
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT payment_status,COUNT(payment_id) n FROM payments GROUP BY payment_status

clear_cases.query: 统计各会员等级的用户数量
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT member_level,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) n FROM user_memberships GROUP BY member_level

clear_cases.query: 统计2026年8月各门店名称的订单实付金额，按金额降序取前10名
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT s.store_name,SUM(o.paid_amount) sales FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id=s.store_id WHERE o.ordered_at>='2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 10

clear_cases.query: 统计2026年8月各会员等级的订单实付金额
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT m.member_level,SUM(o.paid_amount) sales FROM orders o JOIN user_memberships m ON o.user_id=m.user_id WHERE o.ordered_at>='2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY m.member_level

clear_cases.query: 统计各支付方式成功支付的金额总和
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT payment_method,SUM(payment_amount) amount FROM payments WHERE payment_status='success' GROUP BY payment_method

clear_cases.query: 统计已完成退款中各退款原因的退款金额总和
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT refund_reason,SUM(refund_amount) amount FROM refunds WHERE refund_status='completed' GROUP BY refund_reason

clear_cases.query: 统计各物流承运商已送达的包裹数量
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT carrier_name,SUM(package_count) packages FROM shipments WHERE shipment_status='delivered' GROUP BY carrier_name

clear_cases.query: 统计各供应商等级的平均准时交付率
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT supplier_grade,AVG(on_time_rate) avg_rate FROM suppliers GROUP BY supplier_grade

clear_cases.query: 统计2026年8月各商品类目的订单明细实付金额
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.category_name,SUM(i.paid_amount) sales FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id JOIN product_categories c ON p.category_id=c.category_id WHERE o.ordered_at>='2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY c.category_name

clear_cases.query: 查询各仓库可用库存低于安全库存的SKU数量
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT w.warehouse_name,COUNT(DISTINCT i.sku_id) n FROM sku_inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id WHERE i.available_qty<i.safety_stock GROUP BY w.warehouse_name

clear_cases.query: 统计每个广告计划的总广告成本、归因收入和整体投入产出比
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.ad_campaign_name,SUM(s.ad_cost) cost_total,SUM(s.attributed_revenue) revenue,SUM(s.attributed_revenue)/NULLIF(SUM(s.ad_cost),0) roi FROM ad_daily_stats s JOIN ad_campaigns c ON s.ad_campaign_id=c.ad_campaign_id GROUP BY c.ad_campaign_name

clear_cases.query: 统计各店铺2026年8月的平均转化率，按平均转化率降序取前10名
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT s.store_name,AVG(m.conversion_rate) rate FROM daily_store_metrics m JOIN stores s ON m.store_id=s.store_id WHERE m.stat_date>='2026-08-01' AND m.stat_date<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY rate DESC LIMIT 10

clear_cases.query: 计算各优惠券的领取数量、使用数量和使用率
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.coupon_name,COUNT(DISTINCT r.receipt_id) received,COUNT(DISTINCT u.receipt_id) used,COUNT(DISTINCT u.receipt_id)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.receipt_id),0) rate FROM coupons c LEFT JOIN coupon_receipts r ON c.coupon_id=r.coupon_id LEFT JOIN coupon_usages u ON r.receipt_id=u.receipt_id GROUP BY c.coupon_name

clear_cases.query: 计算各站内搜索关键词的搜索次数和转化率，按搜索次数降序取前20名
clear_cases.gold_sql: SELECT keyword,COUNT(search_id) searches,AVG(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) rate FROM search_events GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY searches DESC LIMIT 20
